evidence_quotes.agenda: 'I'd like to know do you have any specific concern or what are you most worried about for this upcoming [move]?' — asked after the full inventory probe.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer flagged an antique stone/metal/leather table; rep asked 'tell me more about it' and kept surfacing more fragile items (mirrored tables, TVs, lamps) rather than closing the topic after the first answer.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'you're not [bound by] the estimate, you only pay for the actual time... if you guys are planning to take a car load or stage the boxes near the entrance, that really [keeps] the time down' covers window + self-prep.

top_strength: Genuinely dug into the fragile-items concern with a real 'tell me more' follow-up instead of a single reassurance, and gave sound, specific advice (stick with two movers, not three) that put the customer's interest ahead of upselling a bigger crew.
coaching_note: Neither differentiator sheet (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover) or the On-Time/Communication takeaway ever lands, even with a customer clearly anxious about fragile antiques — the $2,000 damage-coverage reassurance in particular would have landed well right after the table conversation.
